root=/bench/repo
entities="User Memo Attachment MemoRelation MemoShare Reaction Inbox IdentityProvider InstanceSetting UserIdentity UserSetting"

for ent in $entities; do
  pkgs=$(grep -r --include='*.go' -E "store\.${ent}\b|\*store\.${ent}\b|\[\]\*store\.${ent}\b|store\.${ent}\{" "$root/server" "$root/internal" "$root/cmd" 2>/dev/null \
    | cut -d: -f1 | xargs -I{} dirname {} | sort -u)
  n=$(echo "$pkgs" | grep -c . || echo 0)
  echo "$n $ent"

done

IdentityProvider, InstanceSetting, and UserSetting showed zero external references. Likely causes include naming differences or storepb usage.

Checking whether IdentityProvider uses a storepb path or a prefixed name. Also searching for imports that reference entity types without the store prefix.

args.command:
bash << 'BASH'
root=/bench/repo
entities="User Memo Attachment MemoRelation MemoShare Reaction Inbox IdentityProvider InstanceSetting UserIdentity UserSetting Role RowStatus Visibility"

count_entity() {
  local ent="$1"
  declare -A seen
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    # must import store package
    grep -q 'github.com/usememos/memos/store"' "$f" || continue
    # match store.Type or standalone Type in type positions (heuristic)
    if grep -qE "store\.${ent}\b|\*store\.${ent}\b|store\.${ent}\{|\[\]\*store\.${ent}\b" "$f"; then
      d=$(dirname "$f"); d=${d#$root/}
      seen[$d]=1
    fi
  done < <(find "$root/server" "$root/internal" "$root/cmd" -name '*.go')
  echo "${#seen[@]}"
}

for ent in $entities; do
  n=$(count_entity "$ent")
  echo "$n $ent"
done
BASH
